lines.text: Did you know? Form is Latin for shape.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus shape?

words.ex: The old factory was transformed into an art centre.
Students must wear a uniform at this school.
All products must conform to safety standards.

publish.title: Form root: transform, uniform and conform
publish.value: Form comes from Latin "forma" (shape, form). Words: transform, uniform and conform. transform = trans + form; uniform = uni + form; conform = con + form.
